title: Federal judge denies request to release man shot by immigration agents in New York
summary_full: Oscar Belgal, a Dominican national, was shot by ICE agents as he drove his five-year-old son home from schoolA federal judge on Friday declined to release from custody a man who was shot and wounded by immigration officers as they arrested him in New York in October.The US district court judge Hector Gonzalez said in a written ruling that agents may have made a procedural error in serving an arrest warrant on Oscar Belgal before he was given a notice to appear in immigration court. However, he wrote, that was merely a technical error that does not require Belgal to be released from federal custody pending deportation proceedings. Continue reading...
